body:
We used an offline VM running a copy of our Agie Classic Cut 2S machine control. We imported the two die openings in one plate. The control plotted ten cutting blocks, contained the cuts within their respective openings and applied the four inward offsets on all 76 faces. Each rough separation measured 1 mm.

All controller runs were offline. No physical cut was made.

Port to the current frame: head `1e12c77a4`, stacked on #2979 (`17cb6f617`).

- The merge of `17cb6f617` took the zero-step setup of #2984 for all conflicting files. The die pair is ported as behaviour onto that frame. The old writer is not used.
- New: `PunchGroup20::encode_die` (the PAIR20 records with `c_die`), die pairs in `export_group_with_review`, and rim matching to one of N openings in `operation/agie_die.rs`.
- The ported DUODI20 job was imported on the emulated control: `CCB030[0]` and Matrijs on both works, `CCB030[4]` with 245/155/140/134 µm after TECCUT, `geen fouten`, and a plot with no cutting move across the plate between the openings. The body has the full readings.
- Gate: quick gate green except the known red #3774. Strict clippy clean.

Needs changes before merge. This is a SAFETY-tier review.

I reviewed the full diff against current upstream/main and its current AGENTS.md. There is no earlier collaborator review on this head.

The local trial merge is `390978a6fd711d24b937b1bed32bfcfafe2558b9`. Its first parent is the PR head. Its main parent is `f2aa981b51a3453428fb294c6c71c575a0178ef6`.

The rim checks match each selection to a full-height opening. The group checks keep the complete cutting areas apart. Both works use one CCB030 quality. I found no code blocker.

Results, run locally:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. The geometry change selects the batch fallback. All 1,203 steps passed. There were no stalls. Strict clippy passed with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- The app library: 305 passed. The UI library: 1,586 passed, 8 ignored.
- `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed each.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: PASS. All 11 light tests passed across 6 steps, including the release prebuild. There were no failures or stalls.

Extra suites run:

I found the readers of the changed golden directories and ran these suites again by name after the quick gate.

- `camcraft-post --lib`: 143 passed.
- `camcraft-post --test agie_cutoff_setup`: 4 passed.
- `camcraft-post --test agie_die_group_setup`: 5 passed.
- `camcraft-post --test agie_group_setup`: 4 passed.
- `camcraft-post --test agie_safe_setup`: 8 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test agie_native`: 27 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test agie_quality`: 3 passed.

Mutations:

I ran two input mutations from the PR through the built CLI, in fresh temporary directories. I did not change the source.

- Same opening selected twice: RED. Export failed with the clear-band diagnostic. No job directory was written.
- Threading hole in the other opening: RED. Generation failed because the die start hole was outside its profile. No job directory was written.
- Original pair before and after the mutations: GREEN. Each run matched both ISO files, the SBL and the SBR byte for byte.

Goldens checked:

I read the added ISO, SBL and SBR lines. The die ISOs close their own contours and differ by the expected X translation. Each work binds its own geometry and hole. Both works state `c_die`, a 1 mm separation and the shared quality. The circle and racetrack arcs have the stated incremental centres. FINE20 changes the quality request. LOWER20 uses distinct air endpoints and no separation.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:235`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. This diff adds two visible cutoff controls. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit them to the PR branch.
2. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149`: Add `Process change: yes` to the PR body. This diff changes a process file. Leave `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` unchanged. Also put `Fixes #2977` at the end of the body, after the generated footer.
3. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/FINE20.ISO:1`: Add a `Goldens moved` section for the full current diff. List the added CIRCLE20, RACE20 and FINE20 files, plus DUODI201 and DUODI202. Also list the added DUODI20, LOWER20 and PAIR20 setup files in `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/`. Explain the intended additions. The current body names the die-pair goldens but describes the inherited goldens as unchanged. These files are additions relative to current upstream/main.
4. `crates/app/tests/agie_quality.rs:1`, `crates/post/tests/agie_cutoff_setup.rs:1`, `crates/post/tests/agie_die_group_setup.rs:1`, `crates/post/tests/agie_group_setup.rs:1`: Give the required one-line reason for each new top-level test binary in the body. Alternatively, put the tests in existing domain directory suites. Current AGENTS.md requires this reason.

No physical cut was made. Full heavy lanes are not required for this P6 PR under current upstream/main policy.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
This PR goes back to draft for the review fixes. The fix moves the new top-level test binaries into existing suites. The PR is flagged ready again when the gate is green.

Reply to the review of `1e12c77a4` (comment 7126704870). New head: `7a97b0f57`.

The parent PRs #2972, #2974, #2978 and #2979 are merged on main. This head merges the current `origin/main` (`83e5e8a37`) with no hand edits, so the diff against main is the die pair only.

1. **Screenshots** (`wire_page.rs:235`): the body has the before/after pair from the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. The cutoff controls are on main now (#2972), so this diff no longer changes `wire_page.rs`.
2. **`Process change: yes`** (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149`): the skill change came with #2972 and is on main now. The diff of this head against main changes no process file, so I removed the line from the body. `PROCESS_VERSION` is not changed. `Fixes #2977` is the last line of the body.
3. **Goldens moved** (`FINE20.ISO:1`): the body lists the additions relative to the current main: `DUODI201.ISO`, `DUODI202.ISO`, `DUODI20.SBL` and `DUODI20.SBR`. The CIRCLE20, RACE20, FINE20, LOWER20 and PAIR20 files are on main now. No golden file of main changes.
4. **New top-level test binaries**: `agie_die_group_setup.rs` moved unchanged into the existing suite `agie_safe_setup`, as the module `die_group` (only the golden paths changed to `../golden/`). The suite has 21 tests (16 on main + 5). `agie_quality`, `agie_cutoff_setup` and `agie_group_setup` are modules of `agie_native` and `agie_safe_setup` on main now. The PR adds no top-level test file. The body has a "Test layout" section.

**Review item of #2992 that belongs to this PR** (`crates/app/src/operation/agie_die.rs:13`, comment 7129805821): commit `afe9a7a82` moves the plate check and the opening match into `camcraft_geometry::die_opening` (`check_die_plate`, `matching_opening`). The app keeps only the selection lookup (`GenJob.contour_sel`). The order of the checks and all diagnostics are unchanged. New unit tests: `die_opening::tests::a_plate_needs_the_stated_openings_inside_the_stock` and `die_opening::tests::a_closed_rim_matches_its_own_opening_only`.

Pinning tests: `agie_safe_setup` `die_group::die_group_files_match_the_control_checked_die_pair` and the four other `die_group::` tests, `agie::die_group_tests`, the two `die_opening::tests`, and `agie_native` `die_group::` (CLI output equals the DUODI goldens).

Gate on `7a97b0f57`: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`, batch fallback: 1201 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Strict clippy (`-D warnings`, all targets): clean. The merge with main is clean.

Delta class (`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 2981 --reviewed 1e12c77a4`): NEW CODE. The new commits are `958442a85` (the test move), `afe9a7a82` (the geometry move), and merges of main and of the stack branches with no hand edits.

Ready for a re-check.

Clean review. No blocking change found. This is a SAFETY-tier review.

I checked current upstream/main's AGENTS.md and the complete remaining diff. The local trial merge is `a54ff12120715738d9497664d8f7ca8f23569750`. Its first parent is the PR head. Its main parent is `02bf65d933f3382ad3eaa305a4bbd6e44363abad`.

Earlier findings, from [the previous review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2981#issuecomment-7126704870):

1. Screenshots: satisfied. The body links before and after images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The current diff changes no UI file.
2. Process declaration and closing issue reference: satisfied or no longer applies. No process file remains in the diff. `PROCESS_VERSION` is unchanged. The body ends with `Fixes #2977`.
3. Goldens moved: fixed. The body lists all four additions against current main. The inherited golden files are now on main.
4. Test layout: fixed. Commit `958442a85` puts the die-group tests in the existing `agie_safe_setup` suite. No new top-level test binary remains.

I also checked the geometry move in `afe9a7a82`. The app reads the selected rim. The geometry crate checks the plate and matches the opening. The tests cover the opening count, stock bounds, incomplete rims and wrong rims.

Local build and test results:

- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 1,201 steps; 1,198 passed, 3 failed, 0 stalled; 29.6 minutes. All builds passed. Strict clippy passed with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- Geometry library: 74 passed. App library: 307 passed.
- `example_catalog`: 41 passed, 4 ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed each.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: all 6 steps passed, including the release build. All 11 light tests passed. No stalls.

The three failed quick steps are pre-existing on this host. I ran the same suites on bare upstream/main at the main SHA above:

`cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib --test egui_app --test shell --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=16`

Both trees have the same results:

- UI library: 1,589 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored. Six report tests fail with `CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")`. `headless_run_succeeds` fails with `no graphics adapter`.
- `egui_app`: 5 passed, 3 failed. The headless CLI returns 1 instead of 0.
- `shell`: 20 passed, 1 failed. `headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero` has the same exit-code failure.

No tracking issue was identified for these exact host failures. They do not come from this PR. I restored the trial merge after the comparison.

Extra suites run:

I found every test source that reads the changed golden directories. I ran their suites again by name, after the quick gate:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --lib`: 144 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test agie_safe_setup`: 21 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test agie_native`: 30 passed.

The diff changes no importer and adds no STEP fixture.

Mutations:

I ran two of the PR's input mutations through the built CLI in separate temporary directories. I did not change source files.

- Same opening selected twice: RED. The clear-band check refused the post. No job directory was written.
- Threading hole in the other opening: RED. Generation refused the hole outside the die profile. No job directory was written.
- Original input before and after: GREEN. Both ISO files, the SBL and the SBR matched their goldens byte for byte.

Goldens checked:

I read all lines of `DUODI201.ISO`, `DUODI202.ISO`, `DUODI20.SBL` and `DUODI20.SBR`. Both contours close within their own opening. The right contour has the expected 60 mm X translation. Each work binds its own ISO and hole. Both use `c_die`, 1 mm separation and the one CCB030 quality. The SBR binds both resources. No existing golden changes.

Requested before merge: none.

No physical cut was made. Full heavy lanes are not required for this P6 PR. The review worktree and branch remain in place.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
